name: player_time_to_throw_from_plays range year_offset pools time-to-throw
description: Time-to-throw is a per-dropback mean; a range year_offset pools SUM(time)/SUM(qualifying dropbacks), not SUM of per-season averages.
expected_query: with "t5e4e8486a4c415b317142c10a6ebcd0f" as materialized (select COALESCE(passer_pid) as pid, SUM(CASE WHEN time_to_throw IS NOT NULL AND (is_sack IS NULL OR is_sack = false) THEN time_to_throw ELSE 0 END) as time_to_throw_from_plays_numerator, SUM(CASE WHEN time_to_throw IS NOT NULL AND (is_sack IS NULL OR is_sack = false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as time_to_throw_from_plays_denominator from "nfl_plays" where not "play_type" = 'NOPL' and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2024, 2025) group by COALESCE(passer_pid)) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, (SELECT SUM(t5e4e8486a4c415b317142c10a6ebcd0f.time_to_throw_from_plays_numerator) / NULLIF(SUM(t5e4e8486a4c415b317142c10a6ebcd0f.time_to_throw_from_plays_denominator), 0) FROM t5e4e8486a4c415b317142c10a6ebcd0f WHERE t5e4e8486a4c415b317142c10a6ebcd0f.pid = player.pid) AS "time_to_throw_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
